title: Balanced tensor with a finite free internal module
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be an abelian symmetric monoidal category [def-sp-abelian] whose tensor product is additive in each variable and for which $Z\otimes-$ and $-\otimes Z$ preserve colimits for every $Z$. Let $R$ be a commutative monoid object and $S$ a monoid object [sk-def-sfb-ring-object]. Let $P$ be an $S$-$R$-bimodule [def-sfb-bimod-objects], with left action $a_P$ and right action $r_P:P\otimes R\to P$; write $P$ also for its underlying left $S$-module [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. For a left $R$-module $M$ with action $\gamma_M$, define $T_P(M)=P\otimes_R M$ to be the coequalizer
$$
(P\otimes R)\otimes M\mathrel{\substack{\xrightarrow{r_P\otimes M}\\[-2pt]\xrightarrow{(P\otimes\gamma_M)\circ\alpha_{P,R,M}}}}P\otimes M,
$$
with quotient $q_M$ and induced left $S$-action through $P$. For an $R$-linear $g:M\to N$, $T_P(g)$ denotes the induced $S$-linear map characterized by $T_P(g)q_M=q_N(P\otimes g)$. Let $R$ denote its regular left module, let $R^k$ be the finite biproduct of $k$ regular modules [def-sfb-finitely-presented-module], and put $P^k=\bigoplus_{i\in\operatorname{Fin}(k)}P$ in $\operatorname{Mod}_S(\mathcal C)$, with injections $\iota_i^R,\iota_i^P$.
There is an $S$-linear isomorphism $c:T_P(R)\xrightarrow{\sim}P$ with
$$c q_R=r_P,\qquad c^{-1}=q_R(P\otimes\eta_R)(\varrho_P^{\mathcal C})^{-1},$$
where $\eta_R:\mathbf1\to R$ is the unit and $\varrho_P^{\mathcal C}:P\otimes\mathbf1\xrightarrow{\sim}P$ is the ambient right unitor. For every $k\geq0$ there is a unique $S$-linear isomorphism $c_k:T_P(R^k)\xrightarrow{\sim}P^k$ satisfying
$$c_k T_P(\iota_i^R)=\iota_i^P c\quad(i\in\operatorname{Fin}(k)).$$
Its inverse satisfies
$$c_k^{-1}\iota_i^P=q_{R^k}(P\otimes\iota_i^R)(P\otimes\eta_R)(\varrho_P^{\mathcal C})^{-1}.$$
For $k=0$ this is the unique isomorphism $T_P(0)\cong0$. No flatness of $P$ as a right $R$-module is assumed.
